subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw accept resetSessionEntryLifecycle as a permanent public Plugin SDK/runtime contract, including owner-coordinated harness reset semantics, for this Teams lifecycle fix?
rationale: Tests establish implementation behavior but cannot decide whether this general session mutation belongs in the long-term external plugin contract or should be exposed through a narrower owner-controlled seam.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Accept the documented owner checks, stale-event guards, active-work fence, rollback, and harness handoff as the supported plugin lifecycle-reset API.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the Teams behavior but redesign the callable surface so plugins request a more constrained core-owned lifecycle operation instead of receiving the general reset callback.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the linked bug and this PR open until session lifecycle ownership and the permanent SDK contract are settled.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented owner checks, stale-event guards, active-work fence, rollback, and harness handoff as the supported plugin lifecycle-reset API.

likelyOwner.reason: They directly narrowed the PR's lifecycle scope and have the strongest recent Teams state-management history visible in the review evidence.
